svg.aria-label: The spinWheel function line by line, with a handwritten note beside each line. probs is the list of 65 chances, one for each possible next letter, in ID order, adding up to 1. let r = random() picks a point on the wheel, a number from 0 to 1, say 0.6. The for loop walks round the wheel one slice at a time, from ID 0. r minus equals probs of i takes away this slice's size. If r is now 0 or less, the walk has gone past the point and this slice wins: for 0.6, that is ID 53, the letter o. The last return is only a safety net, in case rounding leaves the total under 1.
svg.text: Spinning the wheel, line by line
From minigptEngine.ts, the code behind the live demo; the handwritten notes are my own reading of each line

svg.text: export function spinWheel(probs: Float32Array, random: () => number = Math.random): number {

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: let r = random();

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: for (let i = 0; i < probs.length; i++) {

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: r -= probs[i];

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: if (r <= 0) return i;

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: return probs.length - 1;
